title: Add a "position" parameter/property to st.sidebar in order to be able to display the sidbar at LEFT, TOP, RIGHT of the screen
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Add possibility to display  the st.sidebar on different positions on the screen (i.e. LEFT or TOP or RIGHT)

### Why?

Sidebar seems to be fixed at the left side of the screen - more customization possibilities would be great

### How?

adding a "position" parameter to exiting st.sidebar (with possibility to  select the whished positioing for the sidebar: LEFT, TOP, RIGHT, BOTTOM?)

### Additional Context

_No response_

comments.body:

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-7311)
Hey, can I ask why you'd want to show the sidebar in a different position?
Because I would appreciate as much flexibility as possible when it comes to site layout.
Top-level menu would be great, but, personally, I don't see current sidebar there
Not sure for top and bottom but would definitely like to have the option to have the sidebar on the right of the screen.

Closing this in favor of: 
https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/1980
https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8186

We also provide a `st.bottom` container to place elements at the bottom and a `position="top"` to place the navigation bar at the top of the app.
